plan.summary: Add optional ?tenant=<id> query parameter to POST /api/v1/ops/auth/quicklogin so smoke/ops scenarios can mint a tenant-scoped JWT (e.g., tenant=5050 for Zoho OAuth Adim 2 smoke). Default behaviour (tenant=0 superadmin) preserved. Endpoint remains gated by inmaAuthMockEnabled feature flag.
plan.q_intent: Zoho OAuth Adim 2 prod smoke testi icin tenant 5050 JWT'si gerekli. Mevcut quicklogin sadece tenant=0 (superadmin) verir; Zoho /api/v1/zoho/connect-url JWT'den tenant claim'i alir, dolayisiyla tenant-scoped JWT zorunlu. Q karari: quicklogin'e opsiyonel tenant query param ekle (mini paket). INMA gercek login alternatifi reddedildi (creds yok); /admin/quick-login pattern mevcut degil.
plan.interview_notes: Q sectigi: mini paket query param override. Default davranis korunuyor (back-compat). Endpoint inmaAuthMockEnabled gate'i altinda (prod'da kapali olmali). Validation: non-negative int, aksi 400.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: POST /api/v1/ops/auth/quicklogin?tenant=5050 -> 200 OK, tenant_id=5050, full_name='Admin (tenant 5050)', JWT decode'da tenantId=5050.
inmaAuthMockEnabled=false iken endpoint 503 doner (degisiklik bu gate'i bypass etmiyor).
Build PASS: dotnet build src/Invekto.Backend 0 hata.

gr_list.description: Program.cs quicklogin handler: ctx.Request.Query['tenant'] oku, bos degilse int.TryParse + non-negative kontrol; basarisiz -> 400 ErrorResponse (GeneralValidation).
jwtGenerator.GenerateToken cagirisinda hardcoded 0 yerine parsed tenantId kullan.
Response payload: tenant_id alanini parsed deger, full_name dinamik ('Super Admin' tenant=0; 'Admin (tenant N)' aksi).
Log mesajinda issued tenant_id'yi belirt (audit izi).

verification_questions.question: Default davranis (no query) tenant=0 doner mi? Back-compat korundu mu?
Negatif/non-numeric tenant input rejekt edilir mi (400 + spesifik error code)? Silent fallback yok mu?
inmaAuthMockEnabled gate yerinde mi? Prod'da bu flag false oldugu icin override exposure yok mu?
Microservice isolation: yeni Invekto.* using yok, sadece mevcut JwtGenerator (Invekto.Shared.Auth) kullaniliyor.

forbidden_areas: Auth middleware (TenantContext) - sadece JWT issuer degisiyor
intentional_exclusions: tenant_id existence check (DB lookup) - quicklogin zaten dev/mock gate altinda, ekstra DB roundtrip gereksiz

user_facing_errors: INV-GEN-VAL 'tenant query param must be non-negative integer' (400)
error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: Invalid input -> explicit 400. Missing input -> default tenant=0 (documented back-compat). Gate failure (inmaAuthMockEnabled=false) -> 503 (mevcut davranis).

verdict.notes: Iter 0 FAIL: CQ12/Q2 generic ErrorCodes.GeneralValidation kullanimi spesifik INV-XX-NNN yerine. Iter 1 PASS 12/12 CQ + 5/5 CoVe: yeni INV-OPS-001 (OpsQuickLoginInvalidTenant) Shared/ErrorCodes.cs'e eklendi + arch/errors.md OPS bolumu dokumante edildi + Program.cs yeni kodu kullanir.
